official.deadline_note: The call states that applications close impreterivelmente (without extension) at 16h Brasilia on 23 October 2026; the platform header also shows an end date of 15/12/2026 17:00, which is the listing window covering results, appeals and implementation rather than the application deadline.
official.application_cycle: CAPES-Global.Edu 2027 start cycle - overseas activities in September and October 2027, with scholarship implementation in April 2027
official.status_note: The call page shows 'Edital aberto' with the application window running from 15/09/2026 to 23/10/2026 16:00 Brasilia, and the form counter showed zero registered applicants on the verification date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Item 2.8: Fiocruz and CAPES are not responsible for expenses related to the payment of administrative and academic fees (tuition fees) and research (bench fees), and will not grant any allowance for accompanying persons or dependants.
benefits: Mensalidade, to contribute to the holder's maintenance expenses in the destination country, paid by CAPES directly into the holder's bank account (item 2.4 a)
Auxilio Deslocamento, for round-trip air tickets in economy class and promotional fare, paid in the currency practised for the destination (item 2.4 b)
Auxilio Instalacao, for the holder's initial accommodation expenses in the destination country, paid in a single instalment at the start of the award (item 2.4 c)
Auxilio Seguro-saude, for health insurance with coverage in the destination country (item 2.4 d)
Adicional localidade, where the host institution is located in cities considered high cost, per Portaria no 110 of 28 April 2025 (item 2.4 e)
Up to 10 scholarships: 7 with a duration of 6 months and 3 with a duration of 9 months, with overseas activities starting in September and October 2027 (item 2.1)
eligibility: Be Brazilian, or a foreigner with authorisation of residence or former permanent visa in Brazil; foreign candidates need a regular CPF registration with the Brazilian Federal Revenue (item 3.3.2 a)
Not hold a doctoral title in any field of knowledge at the time of application (item 3.3.2 b)

Be duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as a student of a Fiocruz graduate programme that is part of the CAPES Global network and linked to its Strategic Themes, as listed in Annex I (item 3.3.2 c)
Have passed the qualifying examination and completed at least two terms, and leave a minimum of six months in Brazil for credit completion and thesis defence after the stay (items 3.3.2 d, e and f)
Not have previously held a Doutorado Sanduiche no Exterior scholarship in this or any earlier doctoral course (item 3.3.2 g)
Hold a valid ORCID identifier added as a link in the Lattes CV, and not be in default with CAPES or any public administration body (items 3.3.2 k and m)
Present an acceptance letter from the host institution or its supervisor (Annex V) and language-fluency declarations from both supervisors (Annexes VI and VII) (items 3.3.2 h, i and j)
requirements: Register in only one of the five calls issued by the Fiocruz Managing Committee; candidates registering in more than one have all registrations automatically cancelled and voided (items 1.4 and 4.8)
Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form available on the call page, from 15/09/2026 until 16:00 Brasilia on 23/10/2026 (item 4.2)
Upload all mandatory documents as PDFs without a password, legible and clearly displayed (item 4.2)
Indicate one main Strategic Theme and up to two alternatives among the five themes of the CAPES Global network (item 2.3)
First-time users of the Fiocruz site must register before applying, using the link on the application page (item 4.1 of the call page)
Accept the conditions of the call and of Portaria no 289 of 28 December 2018, with no claim of ignorance (items 4.2 and 4.11)
documents: Anexo III - qualification of the international partnership
Official photo identification document with CPF, or, for foreigners, CRNM plus CPF issued by the Brazilian Federal Revenue with the permanent residence authorisation
Anexo IV - letter from the postgraduate programme coordinator confirming items 3.3.2 c to f
Letter from the Brazilian advisor, free format, maximum one page, dated and signed on institutional letterhead
Academic transcript of the ongoing course, a summary of the current doctoral project of up to 1 page/500 words, and the updated Lattes CV link
Anexo V - declaration from the foreign co-supervisor on letterhead approving the research plan and stating the start and end month and year
Anexo VI and Annex VII - dated and signed language-fluency declarations from the foreign co-supervisor and the Brazilian supervisor
Anexo II - research plan of up to 5 pages, plus the foreign co-supervisor's CV of up to 5 pages covering production from 2022-2026
selection_criteria: Block 1 - quality, relevance and impact of the proposal: excellence and relevance of the work plan, institutional impact and strengthening of the network/PPG, adherence to the Strategic Theme, feasibility of the activity plan - up to 50 points
Block 2 - academic merit and pertinence of the foreign institution, with higher value where the host institution is a network partner - up to 35 points

Block 3 - internationalisation and reduction of asymmetries: PPG in the North, Northeast or Centre-West regions, emerging PPGs graded 3 or 4, and proposals aimed at Global South or BRICS+ countries - up to 15 points
Additional equity score of up to 9 points for ethnic-racial belonging, disability and gender in under-represented areas, supported by documentation submitted at application (items 4.3 and 5.3.2)
Ties are broken, in order, by Block 3 score, then Block 1, then Block 2, then the candidate's age (item 5.5)
coverage: Mensalidade for the holder's maintenance expenses in the destination country
Auxilio Deslocamento for round-trip economy airfare, paid in the currency of the destination, with amounts set by geographic region
Auxilio Instalacao for initial accommodation costs, paid in one instalment at the start of the grant
Auxilio Seguro-saude for health insurance covering the destination country
Adicional localidade for host institutions in cities considered high cost
CAPES will not cover any costs beyond those described in item 2.4, including tuition fees, bench fees and support for accompanying persons or dependants (item 2.7)
application_method: Electronic application form on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual editais platform, linked from the call page
Prior registration on the Fiocruz site is required for first-time applicants
All uploads made as password-free, legible PDFs inside the application window
official.application_route: Apply once through the Fiocruz Campus Virtual electronic form on the call page, uploading every annex as an unlocked PDF; results and appeals are published on the same page.
official.study_mode: The call publishes no full-time or part-time designation; the holder must be engaged in academic activities for the entire period abroad, which must coincide with the host institution's academic term (item 8.12 and 8.13).
official.citizenship_residency: Open to Brazilians and to foreigners holding authorisation of residence or former permanent visa in Brazil; foreign candidates need a regular CPF registration (item 3.3.2 a).
official.international_eligibility: Foreign nationals may apply provided they hold residence authorisation and a CPF, but eligibility is in practice restricted to doctoral students enrolled in Fiocruz graduate programmes of the CAPES Global network.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must choose one main Strategic Theme and up to two alternatives from the five themes of the CAPES Global network, and their Fiocruz doctoral programme must be linked to those themes per Annex I; priority is given to destinations in the geopolitical Global South and in BRICS+ countries (item 3.3.5).
official.research_requirement: A research plan per Annex II of up to 5 pages in Times New Roman 12 with summaries of the activities in Portuguese and English, a justification demonstrating the impossibility of carrying out the work in Brazil, and a 1-page/500-word summary of the doctoral project (items 4.2 f and m).
official.duration: 6 months (7 scholarships) or 9 months (3 scholarships), selected at application (item 2.1)
official.description: The Managing Committee of the Fiocruz, a member of the CAPES Global Network for Sustainable Development, Science and Health, opens a public call to select doctoral students of its graduate programmes for a research stay (estagio para o desenvolvimento de pesquisa) at a foreign higher education institution under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme (CAPES Edital no 13/2025), after which the student returns to Brazil, within the CAPES regulatory deadline, to complete and defend the thesis.
official.region: Brazil-administered call open to destinations worldwide, with priority for Global South and BRICS+ countries (catalogue region: Latin America)
official.program_type: Doutorado Sanduiche no Exterior (sandwich doctorate) mobility scholarship under the CAPES-Global.Edu / Redes para Internacionalizacao Institucional programme
official.english_requirement: No IELTS or TOEFL score is published. The call requires a signed language-fluency declaration from the foreign co-supervisor (Annex VI) and from the Brazilian supervisor (Annex VII), including when the destination country is Portuguese-speaking, and allows the alternative of evidencing foreign-language proficiency according to CAPES requirements (items 4.2 i, j and k).

not_confirmed: funding_currency for a specific destination: the same monthly figure of 1,300 is published in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, SEK, DKK, NOK and CHF according to the destination country, so no single currency applies
study_mode: the call publishes no full-time or part-time designation
english_requirement: no IELTS or TOEFL minimum score is published, only supervisor fluency declarations and an alternative CAPES proficiency route
exact travel, installation, insurance and locality supplement amounts for a given destination, which depend on region and city under the CAPES annexes
verification.notes: Checked the Fiocruz call page and the full text of Edital no 01/2026 do Comite Gestor/Fiocruz (PDF, 15 pages) for dates, eligibility, documents, selection criteria and financed items; the call itself publishes no monetary figure and refers to Portaria CAPES no 1 of 3 January 2020, so the monthly value and the allowances were taken from the CAPES values table on the official gov.br/capes page that hosts that Portaria.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an internal Fiocruz call, not an open international competition: you must already be a doctoral student registered on Sucupira inside a Fiocruz programme that belongs to the CAPES Global network and is tied to one of its five Strategic Themes. Ten scholarships are on offer, seven for six months and three for nine months, with the overseas stay starting in September or October 2027, which means the real deadline pressure is the 16:00 Brasilia cut-off on 23 October 2026. Merit is scored out of 100 points, so your work plan and the strength of the host institution carry most of the weight, while an extra 9 equity points can be claimed only if the supporting documents are uploaded at application time.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A Fiocruz doctoral student in a CAPES Global network programme who has passed qualification, has a foreign host already lined up and can still defend the thesis after returning.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your programme appears in Annex I and pick your main Strategic Theme plus two alternatives before drafting anything else
Count backwards from your thesis defence date: the stay you choose must leave at least six full months in Brazil for credits and defence
Ask the host co-supervisor for the Annex V letter on institutional letterhead with exact start and end month/year matching the 6- or 9-month duration
Get both fluency declarations (Annexes VI and VII) signed and dated, even if the host country is Portuguese-speaking
Check that your ORCID is live and linked inside your Lattes CV, then paste the Lattes link into the form
Verify you are not in default with CAPES and that you hold no other same-level federal scholarship, or get the supervisor's formal authorisation for any accumulation
common_rejection_risks: Registering in more than one of the five Fiocruz calls, which voids every registration with no exception
The stay not leaving six months in Brazil for credit completion and thesis defence
A missing or unjustified qualifying examination, since only the programme coordinator's Annex IV statement can cover it
Dates that disagree between the acceptance letter, the research plan and the chosen duration
Already holding a Doutorado Sanduiche no Exterior scholarship, in this or any earlier doctorate
A late or unfinished submission, since the call warns the 23 October 16:00 deadline will not be extended for technical problems
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees and bench fees at the host institution, visa and passport issuance costs, any costs of companions or dependants, and every expense outside the five financed items listed in item 2.4; any extension of the stay beyond the granted period is authorised with no cost to CAPES, so it must be self-funded.
document_audit: Letters from the host institution must be on letterhead and carry the full institution name including campus or institute, complete address, institutional website, contact phone, date, signature and the signatory's email and phone
The Brazilian advisor's letter is capped at one page and must justify the stay and show technical-scientific interaction with the co-supervisor abroad

The research plan is capped at 5 pages in Times New Roman 12 and needs both a Portuguese and an English summary of the activities, plus a timetable, expected results and the host institution's infrastructure
The co-supervisor's CV must be no longer than 5 pages, with production from 2022 to 2026 and at least a doctoral title
Foreign applicants must supply photo ID with CPF, or CRNM plus CPF together with the permanent residence authorisation
Equity documentation for the 9 extra points must be attached at application, and only proof of admission through affirmative action or a PPG statement is accepted for the ethnic-racial criterion
alerts: Applications close at 16:00 Brasilia on 23 October 2026 with no extension, and the platform header shows a later 15/12/2026 date that belongs to the results and implementation window, not to the application deadline
The same student cannot compete in more than one of the five Fiocruz calls, and earlier applications under other calls void all but the first submission
Priority goes to Global South and BRICS+ destinations, so a proposal aimed at Europe, the United States, Japan or Australia scores lower on Block 3
Results and appeals are published exclusively on the call page, so monitor the daily list rather than email
After implementation the file leaves Fiocruz hands: doubts go through CAPES Linha Direta and approvals by silence are treated as withdrawal, so watch the inbox, including spam
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One electronic form upload, then Fiocruz technical homologation, a merit analysis scored out of 100 plus 9 equity points, and results published on the same call page with the award implemented by CAPES in the SCBA system in April 2027.
